source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine - Engine Mechanical V8, p.6-33

procedures.title: Torsional damper (V8): install, 396 and 427
steps: Set the damper over the crankshaft key.
Pull it onto the crankshaft with Tool J-21058 (see figure 13V in the manual).
Remove the tool.
Install the damper retaining bolt and torque to specifications, then the accessory drive pulley.
Install the radiator and shroud (Section 13) and the fan pulley and fan (Section 6K).
Install the fan belt and set tension with a strand tension gauge.
Corvette: lower the engine and reinstall the front mount through-bolts.
Fill the cooling system, start the engine and check for leaks.
notes: With engine and radiator still in the car, a 1/2"-20 x 5" bolt and 1/2"-20 nut can substitute for the J-21058 bolt and nut.
CAUTION: thread the bolt into the crankshaft at least 1/2".

procedures.title: Torsional damper (V8): install, 302 and 327 325/350 hp
steps: Install the damper as for 396/427 engines, but use a 7/16"-20 x 5" bolt and nut instead of the ones supplied with J-21058.

procedures.title: Crankcase front cover (V8): remove
steps: Remove the oil pan.
Remove the torsional damper.
Remove the water pump (Section 6K).
Remove the front cover bolts, then the cover and gasket; discard the gasket.

procedures.title: Crankcase front cover (V8): install, 302/307/327/350
steps: Check that the cover face and block front face are clean and flat.
Oil the seal; coat a new gasket with gasket sealer and fit cover and gasket over the dowel pins onto the block.
Install the cover screws and torque to specifications.
Install the water pump (Section 6K), torsional damper and oil pan.

procedures.title: Crankcase front cover (V8): install, 396/427
steps: Check that the cover face and block front face are clean and flat.
Oil the seal and put Aligning Tool J-22102 in it (see figure 14V in the manual); fit the cover with a new sealer-coated gasket to the block.
Install the cover screws, torque to specifications, then remove J-22102.
Install the water pump (Section 6K), torsional damper and oil pan.

procedures.title: Front cover oil seal (V8): replace
steps: Cover removed: pry the old seal out from the front with a large screwdriver.

Cover removed: drive in the new seal, open end toward the inside of the cover, with J-995 on 327 (302/307/350) engines (see figure 15V in the manual) or J-22102 on 427 (396) engines (see figure 16V in the manual), supporting the cover at the seal area so it does not distort.
Cover installed: with the damper off, pry the old seal out from the front with a large screwdriver without damaging the crankshaft surface.

Cover installed: drive in the new seal, open end toward the inside, with J-8340 on 327 (302/307/350) engines (see figure 17V in the manual) or J-22102 on 427 (396) engines (see figure 18V in the manual).
